test_single_bare_uri: test the resolve_uris method resolves a single bare s3:// URI to a proxy URL
test_multiple_uris_in_html: test the resolve_uris method replaces multiple s3:// URIs embedded in HTML with proxy URLs
test_list_data: test the resolve_uris method resolves a list of URI strings element-by-element
test_dict_data: test the resolve_uris method resolves only URI values in a dict while leaving plain-text values unchanged
test_mixed_resolvable_and_unresolvable: test the resolve_uris method skips unresolvable URIs and replaces resolvable ones in HTML
